Aisha (docs): Quick PR opened to clean up residency wording and standardize region slugs. PR: https://git.redwood/example/region-slug-and-wording

Jonah P: I can update the SDK snippets to use the canonical slug. Proposed python snippet:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1", api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this")
print(resp.text)
```

Sam K: Good. Also change curl to use ?region=eu-west-1.

Maya R: Legal flagged the phrase 'Data may be stored in multiple regions' as misleading. Please make processing vs persisted explicit.

Priya (legal): Suggested wording: 'Transient processing (for routing or caching) may occur in multiple regions. Persisted storage is kept in the customer-selected residency when residency is enabled (subject to applicable legal requests and compliance controls). Customers using private residency may integrate KMS/HSM to retain key control.'

Aisha (docs): I'll replace the sentence and add a tiny mapping table (UI label -> canonical slug -> display name) and a one-line on-prem note: 'On-prem packages process within customer-managed networks; contact Sales for air-gapped installs.'
